lines: Knox is getting more looks lately: 3.7 targets per game over his last 3, up from 2.3 on the season, for 4.8 PPR points per game.
He has played 10 of BUF's 10 games and 69% of snaps this season, and got 13% of team targets lately.
Week 12 is against KC, who allow the 6th-most PPR points per game to TEs, though we project him for 5.9 PPR.
